summary.text: Noy Holland is the Democratic candidate for Montana State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Llew Jones, with nonpartisan write-in candidate Nate White also running.
A writer and university teacher, Holland said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is an organizer for The Montana Plan to ban corporate spending in elections.

paragraphs.text: Noy Holland said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she is a mother, educator, community organizer and writer who lives southwest of Choteau.
She said she has taught for decades at public universities in Florida, Massachusetts, Alabama and Utah and has published five books of fiction.
Holland advanced from the Democratic primary for Senate District 9 on June 2, 2026.
Her stated key messages were banning dark money in elections, protecting public lands and waters, and affordable energy, including a statewide moratorium on data centers.
She also said she believes in term limits and would limit herself to two terms.
